primary_meaning: God or Jesus Christ as a firm, immovable foundation, ultimate protector, and source of salvation.

alternatives.meaning: The Apostle Peter as the earthly foundation of the Christian Church
The confession of faith made by Peter regarding Jesus as the Messiah
A stumbling stone or rock of offense to those who reject the gospel

notes: The overarching symbol of God or Christ as a dependable foundation is universally accepted. The most significant divergence involves Matthew 16:18, where the rock is debated as being Peter himself (traditionally Catholic), his confession of faith (traditionally Protestant), or Christ alone.
